title: Tikiake Ataata me ngā Whakaahua Pinterest ki te Gallery
description: Tikiake ataata me ngā whakaahua Pinterest ki te Gallery o tō waea, ki tō rorohiko rānei. Koreutu, kāore he taupānga, kāore he takiuru. Anei ngā hipanga.
photoCaption: Tiakina ngā ataata me ngā whakaahua Pinterest.
body:
Kua kite koe i tētahi ataata tohutao, i tētahi whakaaro whakapaipai whare, i tētahi akoranga poto rānei i Pinterest, ā, e hiahia ana koe ki te mātakitaki anō me te kore ipurangi? Ko te āhuatanga tiaki a Pinterest ka waiho noa te Pin ki tētahi papa (board) i roto i te taupānga, nō reira kāore te kōnae e tino tae ki te Gallery o tō waea. I tēnei tuhinga ka ako koe me pēhea te tikiake ataata Pinterest me ngā whakaahua Pinterest ki tō Gallery mā te māmā, koreutu, kāore he taupānga tāpiri, kāore he takiuru.

Ko te taputapu ka whakamahia e tātou ko I Need Save, he kaitikiake tukutuku ka taea te huaki tika i te pūtirotiro o tō waea, o tō rorohiko rānei. Hāunga a Pinterest, ka taea hoki te whakamahi i I Need Save mō ngā pou tūmatanui mai i TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter) me ētahi atu pūhara.

Ngā mea hei whakarite

  • Te hono o te Pin e hiahia ana koe ki te tiaki. Kia mōhio he tūmatanui taua Pin.
  • Tētahi pūtirotiro, hei tauira, ko Chrome i te Android, ko Safari rānei i te iPhone.
  • He hononga ipurangi pūmau, otirā mō ngā ataata roa.

Kāore koe e hiahia ki te waihanga pūkete i I Need Save, kāore hoki he taupānga hei tāuta.

Me pēhea te tikiake ataata Pinterest i tō waea

He ōrite ngā hipanga mō te Android me te iPhone:

  1. Huakina te taupānga Pinterest, ka rapu i te Pin ataata e hiahia ana koe.
  2. Pātōtia te pātene Share (Tiri), kātahi ka kōwhiri i Copy link (Tārua hono).
  3. Huakina tō pūtirotiro, ka haere ki te whārangi tikiake o I Need Save.
  4. Whakapiria te hono ki te pouaka, pātōtia noa iho rānei te pātene Whakapiri.
  5. Pēhia Tikiake, ka tatari mō te wā poto kia puta mai ngā kōwhiringa kōnae.
  6. Kōwhiria te kōwhiringa e hiahia ana koe, hei tauira, he ataata i tētahi kounga.

Mēnā ka huri te pātene ki E whakarite ana…, kaua e katia te whārangi. Ko te tikanga, kei te tukatukahia te ataata, hei tauira, kei te hono tahi te ataata me te oro, kei te hurihia rānei he rerenga (stream) hei MP4. Ina oti, ka tīmata aunoa te tikiake.

Me pēhea te tiaki whakaahua Pinterest

Mō ngā Pin whakaahua, he ōrite tonu te tikanga. Tāruatia te hono o te Pin, whakapiria ki I Need Save, kātahi ka pēhi i Tikiake. I te rārangi kōwhiringa, kōwhiria te Whakaahua, te Whakaahua iti rānei. He whai hua hoki tēnei kōwhiringa mēnā ko te whakaahua uhi anake o tētahi Pin ataata tāu e hiahia ana, hei tauira, hei tohutoro hoahoa māu ake.

Te kōwhiri i te kounga ataata tika

Ka pēhi koe i Tikiake, i te nuinga o te wā ka kite koe i ētahi kōwhiringa kounga pērā i te 360p, te 720p, te 1080p rānei. Ka whakawhirinaki ngā kōwhiringa ka puta ki te ataata taketake, nō reira kāore he kōwhiringa 1080p i ngā Pin katoa.

  • 360p he pai mēnā he iti ō raraunga, kua tata kī rānei te rokiroki o tō waea.
  • 720p he kōwhiringa taurite i waenga i te koi me te rahi o te kōnae.
  • 1080p te mea koi rawa, he pai mō te mātakitaki i te mata nui.

Ka taea e koe te pānui i tētahi whakamārama whānui ake i te tuhinga mō te rerekētanga o te kounga ataata 360p, 720p me te 1080p.

Hāunga te ataata, he kōwhiringa Oro anō hoki. Ka taea e koe te tiki i te oro i te kounga taketake, he MP3 192 kbps rānei kua hurihia mai i te ataata. He pai mēnā ko te puoro papamuri anake o tētahi Pin tāu e whai ana.

Kei hea ngā kōnae Pinterest e tiakina ai?

Ka whakawhirinaki te wāhi o te kōnae ki te pūrere e whakamahia ana e koe:

  • Android me te rorohiko: ka haere te kōnae ki te kōpaki Downloads (Ngā Tikiake). He wā poto pea i mua i te whakaaturanga mai i te taupānga Gallery.
  • iPhone me iPad (Safari): ka haere te kōnae ki te taupānga Files → Downloads. Kia tae ai te ataata ki te taupānga Photos, huakina te ataata i Files, pātōtia Share, kātahi ka kōwhiri i Save Video.

Mēnā kei te pōraruraru tonu koe ki te kimi i te kōnae, whāia te aratohu mō te wāhi o ngā kōnae kua tikiakehia i Android me iPhone.

Ka tukuna tika ngā kōnae mai i Pinterest ki tō pūrere, ā, kāore e puritia ki te tūmau o I Need Save. Nō reira, tiakina ō kōnae hira ki tētahi wāhi māmā ki te kimi anō.

Mēnā ka rahua te tikiake Pinterest

He mea ētahi ka rahua ai te tukanga:

  • Nō tētahi pūkete tūmataiti te Pin, ka kitea noa rānei i muri i te takiuru.
  • Kua herea te ihirangi ki ētahi rohe anake.
  • Kāore i oti katoa te hono i whakapiria, kāore rānei i tika te tārua.

Tāruatia anō te hono mai tonu i te pātene Share, kātahi ka tīmata anō. Kia mahara, kāore rawa e taea te tikiake i ngā ihirangi tūmataiti, i ngā ihirangi e hiahia ana kia takiuru, me ngā ihirangi kua herea ā-rohe.

Whakamahia mā te whakaaro nui

He maha ngā Pin kei roto ngā mahi a ētahi atu, pērā i ngā whakaahua, i ngā tuhi whakaahua, i ngā ataata rānei nā ngā kaihanga. Tikiakehia mō tō ake whakamahinga anake, hei tauira, hei tohutoro, hei mātakitaki tuimotu rānei. Mēnā e hiahia ana koe ki te tuku anō, tonoa tuatahitia he whakaaetanga i te rangatira, ā, whakaingoatia ia.

Ngā pātai auau

He koreutu te tikiake ataata Pinterest i I Need Save?

Āe, he koreutu. Me huaki noa te pae i tō pūtirotiro, kāore he taupānga, kāore he takiuru.

Ka taea te whakamahi i te rorohiko?

Āe. Huakina te Pin i te pūtirotiro o tō rorohiko, tāruatia tōna hono, kātahi ka whakapiri ki I Need Save. Ka haere te kōnae ki te kōpaki Downloads.

He aha te ataata e kore ai e puta tonu ki te Gallery?

I Android, i ētahi wā he wā poto e hiahiatia ana e Gallery hei whakahou i tōna rārangi kōnae. I iPhone, me tiaki tuatahi te ataata mai i te taupānga Files ki Photos mā te tahua Share.
